RobotUnit.description: One robot product, entered from its Construction Robot Schema attributes. Identical machines are one entry with a count.

id.description: The robot's name, a readable product slug. The CRS Name.

count.description: How many identical machines this entry stands for.

status.description: The runtime state of one machine.

physical_property_group.description: The Physical Property group holding the robot's dimensions, hardware, and performance.

operational_requirement_group.description: The Operational Requirement group holding the site conditions and people the robot needs.

PhysicalProperty.description: CRS group 1: the robot's physical dimensions, hardware, and performance.

id.description: Identifier, unique among instances of its class.

level_of_autonomy.description: How independently the robot performs its tasks.

network.description: How the robot communicates and exchanges data.

length.description: How long the item is, recommended in metres.

width.description: How wide the item is, recommended in metres.

height.description: How tall the item is, recommended in metres.

weight.description: How much the item weighs, recommended in kilograms.

load_capacity.description: The maximum weight the robot can carry for extended work, recommended in kilograms.

mobility.description: How the robot moves from one place to another.

speed.description: How fast the robot travels, recommended in metres per second.

navigation.description: Whether the robot can find its own position and plan a path to a destination.

run_duration.description: How long the robot can run continuously on its power source, recommended in minutes.

end_effector.description: The tools the robot's manipulator can attach, such as a bucket or gripper.

manipulator.description: The robot's arm: the links and joints that perform tasks.

coordinate_reach.description: How far the manipulator reaches along each of the robot's three axes, recommended in metres. The CRS Coordinate Reach X, Y and Z.

yaw.description: The manipulator's rotation range around the vertical axis, recommended in degrees.

pitch.description: The manipulator's rotation range around the lateral axis, recommended in degrees.

roll.description: The manipulator's rotation range around the longitudinal axis, recommended in degrees.

manipulator_position.description: Where the manipulator is mounted on the robot, a point in the robot's own frame.

degree_of_freedom.description: How many axes of the manipulator can rotate or extend.

lifting_capacity.description: The maximum weight the manipulator can lift during operation, recommended in kilograms.

sensors.description: The sensors mounted on or around the robot.

PhysicalProperty.title: PhysicalProperty

Sensor.description: One sensor on or around the robot. Belongs to the PhysicalProperty group one hop down.

id.description: Identifier, unique among instances of its class.

sensor_type.description: What kind of sensor this is.

sensor_location.description: Where the sensor sits on the robot, a point in the robot's own frame.

Sensor.title: Sensor

OperationalRequirement.description: CRS group 2: the site conditions and the people the robot needs to work.

id.description: Identifier, unique among instances of its class.

grade.description: The range of ground slopes the robot can work on, recommended in degrees.

temperature.description: The range of temperatures at which the robot works properly, recommended in degrees Celsius.

humidity.description: The range of relative humidity at which the robot works properly, recommended in percent.

site_preparation.description: What the site needs before the robot can work properly on it.

req_number_operators.description: How many people control the robot.

operator_responsibilities.description: What the operator does while the robot performs its tasks.

OperationalRequirement.title: OperationalRequirement

Safety.description: CRS group 3: how the robot protects the people and objects around it.

id.description: Identifier, unique among instances of its class.

emergency_stop.description: Whether the robot stops automatically and immediately when specific conditions are triggered.

safe_distance.description: The minimum distance to keep between humans and the robot while they work together, recommended in metres.

object_detection_range.description: How far away the robot can detect and recognise objects, recommended in metres.

safety_barrier.description: Whether the robot has a facility to avoid collisions with humans or objects.

additional_ppe_requirements.description: Extra personal protective equipment required when humans operate or work with the robot.

minimum_workspace.description: The minimum space the robot needs to operate without collisions, recommended in metres.

Safety.title: Safety

Activity.description: CRS group 4: the capabilities a robot offers and how it performs them. The one required group, because offers is required.

id.description: Identifier, unique among instances of its class.

offers.description: The capability types this robot offers. The CRS Task Type.

productivity.description: How much work the robot does per unit of time, in a unit that fits the activity, for example brick/h. The CRS Productivity with its Productivity Units.

precision.description: How finely the robot repeats its work, recommended in millimetres. The CRS Precision with its Precision Units.

accuracy.description: How close the robot's work comes to the target, recommended in millimetres. The CRS Accuracy with its Accuracy Units.

data_output_type.description: The forms of data the robot's sensors output.

data_output_file_type.description: The file formats of the data the robot's sensors output.

crew_information.description: The composition of the team working with the robot.

crew_responsibilities.description: What the crew does while the robot performs its tasks.

worker_type.description: The kinds of worker who work with the robot.

worker_responsibilities.description: What the workers do while the robot performs its tasks.

description.description: What this is, in one or two plain sentences.

anyOf.description: The kind of object the parameter ranges over.

parameters.description: The declared parameters, keyed by name.

Method.description: One way to decompose a compound task into an ordered network of subtasks, for components of one material category or for any component.

record_type.description: Which class in this schema the record belongs to.

id.description: The method name.

description.description: What this is, in one or two plain sentences.

compound_task.description: The compound task a method decomposes, a subtask names, or an instance realises.

anyOf.description: The kind of object the parameter ranges over.

parameters.description: The declared parameters, keyed by name.

subtasks.description: The subtasks in list order, counted from 1. On a method, the entries of its decomposition; on a compound task instance, the instances that replaced it.

parameter_kind.description: The kind of object the parameter ranges over.

compound_task.description: The compound task a method decomposes, a subtask names, or an instance realises.

arguments.description: The values a subtask passes, in the named task's parameter order: method parameter names or object ids.

tasks.description: The network's tasks in list order, counted from 1, each position its label.

anyOf.description: The id of the object the parameter is bound to: a BuildingComponent, a Space, or a machine such as mason_m1_1, as the parameter's declared kind says.

bindings.description: The instance's parameters bound to object ids, keyed by parameter name.

id.description: The instance's id, unique within the plan.

bindings.description: The instance's parameters bound to object ids, keyed by parameter name.
